title: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell says league could rework TV packages in next media deal
summary: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell has indicated that the league is considering the possibility of restructuring its television packages in the upcoming media deal. This comes in light of the NFL's opt-out clause, which allows the league to resell and redistribute its media rights at the conclusion of the 2029-30 season. Such a move could significantly impact how NFL games are broadcasted and monetized in the future, reflecting the evolving landscape of sports media rights.
